services.desc: At Memory Maker Fishing Charters, we aim to provide the best charter fishing services on Lake Michigan. We operate out of Kenosha, Wisconsin and serve the surrounding areas along the coast of Lake Michigan. Our harbor address is 443 50th St., Kenosha, WI, and our dock number is Slip 135. Our Captain has 9+ years of experience and will use all of it to ensure your time on the Memory Maker, our boat, is an experience to

includes: Fishing rods, reels, bait, nets provided
Fish cleaned and packaged at end of charter
blurb: Guests join guided fishing trips on Lake Michigan aboard the Memory Maker, a 2000 Donelle Sport Fishing Boat with a spacious deck and private washroom. Fishing gear is provided, and the captain has over 9 years of USCG licensed experience. Various packages are offered from 2 to 3 day charters, accommodating 2 to 6 people.
extraNote: If lake too rough, guests notified ahead or at dock and deposit forwarded to another date · Fishing in inclement weather; bring rain gear · Dock Number: Slip 135, Kenosha, WI
